description: This script automates the process of downloading and applying patches from GitHub pull requests to a local PyTorch installation, including argument parsing, patch retrieval, and application.

methods.name: parse_arguments
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments for PR number, target directory, and strip count.

methods.name: get_pytorch_path
methods.description: Retrieves the installation path of PyTorch in the current environment.

methods.name: handle_import_error
methods.description: Handles the case where PyTorch is not installed and exits.

methods.name: download_patch
methods.description: Downloads the patch file for a given PR from GitHub.

methods.name: apply_patch
methods.description: Applies the downloaded patch to the specified directory using the patch utility.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main orchestrator function that coordinates argument parsing, patch download, and application.
